entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After exchanging pleasantries, we w..."
entries.dialogueText: After exchanging pleasantries, we were led inside. The light of the camera flashes nearly blinded us.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Welcome back, Your Majesty. It's a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Welcome back, Your Majesty. It's a delight to have you here with us once again."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was here to finalize our deal wit..."
entries.dialogueText: I was here to finalize our deal with Duke Reinhart and Prime Minister Alvarez. Today, Rizia would officially cede its claim to the Aureus gas field.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Upon our arrival to Castle Reinhart..."
entries.dialogueText: Upon our arrival to Castle Reinhart, we were greeted by the smiling faces of the Palesian and Lespian delegations as well as Duke Reinhart, who waited at the front gates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The city was familiar to me by now...."
entries.dialogueText: The city was familiar to me by now. But the atmosphere was far more welcoming than it had ever been before.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was here to sign our deal with Du..."
entries.dialogueText: I was here to sign our deal with Duke Reinhart as resolved by the AN. After today, Rizia would own 50 percent of the Aureus gas field.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was here to finalize our concessi..."
entries.dialogueText: I was here to finalize our concession to Duke Reinhart, according to the AN's resolution. After today, Rizia's claim on the Aureus gas field would be officially null and void.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina was already inside, standing n..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina was already inside, standing next to the Palesian foreign affairs team. She came to me when we entered the hall.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm glad you made it, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you made it, Father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We took our seats around a large ta..."
entries.dialogueText: We took our seats around a large table along with the delegates from each country's ministry of foreign affairs.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You must be dying to return home...."
entries.dialogueText: "You must be dying to return home. Thank you for accepting this duty, Vina. It means a lot."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good to see you, Vina. How were th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good to see you, Vina. How were the meetings? I'm told there are no issues."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did you miss your old man?""
entries.dialogueText: "Did you miss your old man?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Ha. Not when you put it like that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ha. Not when you put it like that."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""They were long and arduous for sur..."
entries.dialogueText: "They were long and arduous for sure. But honestly, it wasn't as boring as I'd have thought."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For the third time since my coronat..."
entries.dialogueText: For the third time since my coronation, our convoy drove steadily across the cobbled streets of Old Town Pales.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was here to sign our deal with Du..."
entries.dialogueText: I was here to sign our deal with Duke Reinhart as resolved by the AN. After today, Rizia would own 50 percent of the Aureus gas field.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was here to sign our deal with Du..."
entries.dialogueText: I was here to sign our deal with Duke Reinhart. After today, Rizia would own 25 percent of the Aureus gas field. Not as much as I wanted, but better than nothing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was here to finalize our concessi..."
entries.dialogueText: I was here to finalize our concession to Duke Reinhart. After today, the Aureus gas field would officially belong to the Grand Duchy of Pales.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After exchanging pleasantries, we w..."
entries.dialogueText: After exchanging pleasantries, we were led inside. The light of the cameras nearly blinded us as we walked in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Upon our arrival to Castle Reinhart..."
entries.dialogueText: Upon our arrival to Castle Reinhart, we were greeted by the smiling faces of the Palesian delegation as well as Duke Reinhart, waiting for us by the front gate.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Uh... I wouldn't exactly call it *..."
entries.dialogueText: "Uh... I wouldn't exactly call it *dying*. But yes, thank you, Father. I did my best to offer support."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""There were no issues with the agre..."
entries.dialogueText: "There were no issues with the agreement, and I'm told everything is ready for you to sign."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Great work. Keep it up.""
entries.dialogueText: "Great work. Keep it up."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, Vina. You've done an am..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Vina. You've done an amazing job."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come on, then. Let's get this over..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, then. Let's get this over with, shall we?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We were led into the conference roo..."
entries.dialogueText: We were led into the conference room where the meeting was to take place.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I'm looking forward to settling th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm looking forward to settling this Aureus business and paving the way for a thaw between Pales and Rizia once and for all."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Today is not just about signing a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today is not just about signing a deal. It's about laying the foundation for cooperation and mutual benefit between Pales and Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, Duke Reinhart. Your wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Duke Reinhart. Your words mean a lot for me and our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are so kind, Duke Reinhart. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are so kind, Duke Reinhart. Thank you for having us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is a pleasure to be here under..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a pleasure to be here under such promising circumstances. This deal will mark a new chapter for both of our countries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To be fair, I don't need a meeting..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be fair, I don't need a meeting with you to enjoy my visit to this great city."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He started laughing along with ever..."
entries.dialogueText: He started laughing along with everyone else at the table.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I must also thank your daughter. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must also thank your daughter. It's rare that a princess has such a knack for diplomatic intricacies."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I must also thank our partners in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must also thank our partners in the Rizian delegation. They were instrumental in working out all the legal particulars."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Uh... Fair enough!""
entries.dialogueText: "Uh... Fair enough!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina blushed and bowed her head."
entries.dialogueText: Vina blushed and bowed her head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The delegates bowed their heads."
entries.dialogueText: The delegates bowed their heads.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Rizia has agreed to cede half of i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has agreed to cede half of its AN-acknowledged claim to the Aureus field to Pales, granting the Grand Duchy a 75 percent share in total."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Both Rizia and Pales accept the Al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both Rizia and Pales accept the Alliance of Nations' resolution. Ownership of the Aureus gas field will be divided evenly between our countries."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Rizia has agreed to cede its claim..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has agreed to cede its claim to the Aureus gas field, in exchange for lasting peace between the kingdom and the Grand Duchy of Pales."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Both Rizia and Pales accept the Al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both Rizia and Pales accept the Alliance of Nations' resolution. Pales will be granted sole ownership of the Aureus gas field."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was here to finalize our deal wit..."
entries.dialogueText: I was here to finalize our deal with Duke Reinhart. After today, Rizia would own the rights to the Aureus gas field -- and a fully operational pipeline to go with it.

entries.dialogueText: "I missed you, Vina. How was Pales?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""To be honest, I had a great time h..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be honest, I had a great time here."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Axel went above and beyond to make..."
entries.dialogueText: "Axel went above and beyond to make sure of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I see. Is it *Axel* now?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Did he? Don't fall for his theatrics. He's a snake through and through."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good to know. I'm happy you had a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good to know. I'm happy you had a good time here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Be careful, Vina. It's *Duke Reinh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be careful, Vina. It's *Duke Reinhart* and it will stay that way."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Oh God. What are you talking about?""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh God. What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Oh come on, Father. It's not like..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh come on, Father. It's not like that."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I think you have a very distorted..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think you have a very distorted perception of him."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Anyway...""
entries.dialogueText: "Anyway..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I should show you around the Old T..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should show you around the Old Town before we leave. It's amazing how well-preserved it is, even in the middle of all the skyscrapers."

entries.dialogueText: There was a brief silence as his expression soured.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""As I was saying...""
entries.dialogueText: "As I was saying..."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Rizia has agreed to purchase the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has agreed to purchase the sole right  to extract resources from the Aureus Field."

entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has agreed to cede its claim to the Aureus gas field."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""And Pales has agreed to give LesPo..."
entries.dialogueText: "And Pales has agreed to give LesPower shared control over the field."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Inside, we were greeted by the Lesp..."
entries.dialogueText: Inside, we were greeted by the Lespian Prime Minister Alvarez and representatives from LesPower.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""It's good to see you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's good to see you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""In turn, Lespia will be granting e..."
entries.dialogueText: "In turn, Lespia will be granting extraction rights for one-quarter of the Aureus field to Rizian Oil and Gas."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The assistants placed all the neces..."
entries.dialogueText: The assistants placed all the necessary papers in front of us to sign.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I signed the papers."
entries.dialogueText: I signed the papers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room broke into a lengthy round..."
entries.dialogueText: The room broke into a lengthy round of applause.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After exchanging congratulations, w..."
entries.dialogueText: After exchanging congratulations, we were led outdoors into the courtyard, where a stage had been set up for the ceremony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stood in front of a massive boar..."
entries.dialogueText: We stood in front of a massive board with an illustrated map of the Antacean Sea, depicting the Aureus field as a bridge connecting Pales, Rizia and Lespia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stood in front of a massive boar..."
entries.dialogueText: We stood in front of a massive board with an illustrated map of the Antacean Sea, depicting the Aureus field as a bridge connecting Pales and Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The stage itself was an outlandish..."
entries.dialogueText: The stage itself was an outlandish construct, dominated by a towering replica of a drilling rig with a huge logo of LesPower on it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we stepped onto the stage, the a..."
entries.dialogueText: As we stepped onto the stage, the applause of the crowd blended with the loud music from the speakers and the clicks of camera shutters -- overwhelming me for a few seconds.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Made to look like a sophisticated m..."
entries.dialogueText: Made to look like a sophisticated machine with oversized dials, levers, and flashing lights, it was less a piece of industrial equipment and more a prop from a science fiction movie.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The stage itself was an outlandish..."
entries.dialogueText: The stage itself was an outlandish construct, dominated by a colossal replica of a pipeline with a gigantic valve wheel at its center.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The valve was painted in garish col..."
entries.dialogueText: The valve was painted in garish colors and connected to a series of exaggerated, cartoonish pipes that snaked their way across the stage, complete with artificial steam vents and blinking lights.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The geysers were choreographed to e..."
entries.dialogueText: The geysers were choreographed to erupt in unison with the crescendo of the music.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I want to applaud you again, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to applaud you again, Your Majesty, for your decisive actions. We very narrowly avoided an international incident."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I get it, Laurento. You've thanked..."
entries.dialogueText: "I get it, Laurento. You've thanked me enough already."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We couldn't have done it without y..."
entries.dialogueText: "We couldn't have done it without your help, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You know I would have preferred a..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know I would have preferred a better deal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stayed silent."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed silent.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Sorry. I didn't mean to come acros..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry. I didn't mean to come across as a sycophant."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""No time to dwell on that now. We a..."
entries.dialogueText: "No time to dwell on that now. We are here to celebrate."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I want to applaud you again, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to applaud you again, Your Majesty. This was a tense situation, and I believe Rizia made the best of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I get it, Laurento. You've thanked..."
entries.dialogueText: "I get it, Laurento. You've thanked me enough already."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So do I, Mr. Esquibel. Your advice..."
entries.dialogueText: "So do I, Mr. Esquibel. Your advice and assistance was invaluable as usual."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You know I would have preferred a..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know I would have preferred a better deal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stayed silent."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed silent.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Sorry. I do realize how much you h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry. I do realize how much you hate sycophants."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""No time to dwell on that now. We a..."
entries.dialogueText: "No time to dwell on that now. We are here to celebrate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And how was Pales?""
entries.dialogueText: "And how was Pales?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And how did the meetings go?""
entries.dialogueText: "And how did the meetings go?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, I missed you too.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I missed you too."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her face gave way to a wide grin."
entries.dialogueText: Her face gave way to a wide grin.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We would also be inaugurating the o..."
entries.dialogueText: We would also be inaugurating the opening of the Palestream pipeline, delivering gas from the field to Rizia on LesPower's terms.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""We'll finalize the official detail..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll finalize the official details right now. Everything that happens afterwards is just for show."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured at the assistants in th..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured at the assistants in the room. They quickly placed enormous files on the table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento leaned in and whispered."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento leaned in and whispered.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I did not comment."
entries.dialogueText: I did not comment.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I certainly didn't expect this.""
entries.dialogueText: "I certainly didn't expect this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What on earth have they done?""
entries.dialogueText: "What on earth have they done?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, a deal this important deserv..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, a deal this important deserves a spectacle."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It seems the Palesians went above..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems the Palesians went above and beyond for this ceremony."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I can't debate that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can't debate that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pointed at a mock rig surroundin..."
entries.dialogueText: He pointed at a mock rig surrounding the stage. There were a series of artificial geysers, engineered to spout water and colored lights at timed intervals, simulating the dramatic discovery of natural gas.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Okay. That's a little too much.""
entries.dialogueText: "Okay. That's a little too much."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Damn. This is amazing.""
entries.dialogueText: "Damn. This is amazing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Organizing this must have cost as..."
entries.dialogueText: "Organizing this must have cost as much as the drilling facility itself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stayed silent."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed silent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the music came to an end and the..."
entries.dialogueText: As the music came to an end and the applause subsided, I took a closer look at the crowd that was gathered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Politicians, journalists and energy..."
entries.dialogueText: Politicians, journalists and energy executives in their best formal attire were standing somewhat awkwardly amidst this bizarre setting. They cast amused glances at the entertainers who mingled among them - performers dressed as engineers and geologists, complete with exaggeratedly large yellow helmets.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Duke Reinhart then took the microph..."
entries.dialogueText: Duke Reinhart then took the microphone and started explaining the importance of Aureus and the deal that had been finalized.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After thanking and congratulating L..."
entries.dialogueText: After thanking and congratulating LesPower, he turned towards me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After congratulating the delegates..."
entries.dialogueText: After congratulating the delegates and thanking me, he turned towards me.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""...And I invite King Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "...And I invite King Romus."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Reinhart, my friend, I want t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Reinhart, my friend, I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart for your understanding and cooperation over these past few years."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ladies, gentlemen, dear friends. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies, gentlemen, dear friends. I would like to thank Duke Reinhart for inviting us to attend this grand ceremony."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Reinhart, Mr. Alvarez, LesPowe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Reinhart, Mr. Alvarez, LesPower and ladies and gentlemen..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Reinhart, esteemed delegates,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Reinhart, esteemed delegates, ladies and gentlemen..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Reinhart, Prime Minister Alva..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Reinhart, Prime Minister Alvarez. I want to thank you both from the bottom of my heart for your understanding and cooperation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are here to celebrate a truly s..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are here to celebrate a truly significant event. A testament to our countries’ unbreakable bonds and ever-growing ambition."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Relations between Rizia, Pales and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Relations between Rizia, Pales and Lespia have reached a new peak. Our peaceful division of rights to the Aureus field reflects that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Despite a recent deterioration of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite a recent deterioration of Rizian-Palesian relations, we have come together to achieve a historic agreement -- a testament to true diplomacy and our mutual desire for cooperation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Despite attempts to divide our cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite attempts to divide our countries, we deliberately chose the path to peace and mutual growth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Today, we have concluded a histori..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, we have concluded a historic agreement, which is a testament to true diplomacy and our mutual desire for cooperation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Relations between Rizia and Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "Relations between Rizia and Pales have reached a new peak. Our agreement regarding the Aureus field reflects that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are more than excited about the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are more than excited about the massive amounts of energy this gas field will produce."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks to our cooperation with Pal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to our cooperation with Pales, Rizia will soon be transporting billions of cubic meters of natural gas."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am honored to announce the offic..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am honored to announce the official agreement between our countries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let us not forget that, despite ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us not forget that, despite holding the right to claim part ownership of Aureus, Rizia decided to cede all of our rights to our partners in Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the name of peace and friendshi..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the name of peace and friendship, my kingdom selflessly gave away our claim to this massive new gas resource."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am honored to announce the offic..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am honored to announce the official agreement between our three countries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would like to note that extracti..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would like to note that extracting and transporting gas is not as easy as some may think. It will be a great undertaking."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This project has many benefits not..."
entries.dialogueText: "This project has many benefits not only for our people and our country, but also for our neighbors and the region as a whole."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Believe me, ladies and gentlemen,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Believe me, ladies and gentlemen, I am as shocked as every one of you."
entries.menuText: [Gesture at the geysers] "Believe me, ladies and gentlemen, I am as shocked as every one of you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd burst out in laughter."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd burst out in laughter.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This field will hopefully have man..."
entries.dialogueText: "This field will hopefully have many benefits not only for Pales and its people, but also for its neighbors and the region as a whole."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks to the support and professi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to the support and professionalism of LesPower, the project is already being implemented in a timely manner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks to the support and professi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to the support and professionalism of our Palesian counterparts, future energy deals will be completed in a flash."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am certain that in the future, R..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am certain that in the future, Rizia and Pales will implement many more mutually beneficial joint projects, whether in energy or other fields."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I must point out that we live in a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must point out that we live in a volatile region, with conflicts over resources, ideology and religion brewing on all fronts. Let Rizia and Pales serve as an example to all those around us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is my intention that Rizia cont..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is my intention that Rizia continue on the path of peaceful conflict resolution. We will remain one of the most reliable trading partners in Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would like to congratulate the P..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would like to congratulate the Palesian leadership for displaying the political courage and will to accomplish this extraordinary partnership."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Before I finish, I would like to h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before I finish, I would like to highlight the importance of Palesian-Rizian friendship to Southern Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Before I finish, I would like to h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before I finish, I would like to highlight the importance of Lespian-Rizian friendship to Southern Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Before I finish, I would like to h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before I finish, I would like to highlight how important it is for the monarchies of Merkopa to stick together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't bore you all for much long..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't bore you all for much longer. I know you want to see what happens when we turn that wheel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must not forget. Major powers l..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must not forget. Major powers like us have a responsibility to our region. Today, we are showing the world that we take our duties seriously."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Prime Minister Alvarez and I have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Alvarez and I have had our differences in the past. I hope this agreement will go some way towards mending those fences."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Kingdom of Rizia believes in s..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom of Rizia believes in strengthening its cooperation with the member states of the ATO. There is so much we can gain from each other."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Both of our countries are importan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both of our countries are important exporters of natural resources. I believe energy giants like us have a responsibility to the region. And today, we are showing the world that we take our duties seriously."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Reinhart and I have had our d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Reinhart and I have had our differences in the past. I hope this initiative will go some way towards mending those fences."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Kingdom of Rizia sees the peop..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom of Rizia sees the people of Pales as our brothers and sisters. Let today be a step towards unity between us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Both the Rizian and Palesian monar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both the Rizian and Palesian monarchies are important exporters of natural resources. I believe energy giants like us have a responsibility to the region. And today, we are showing the world that we take our duties seriously."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In these turbulent times, the guid..."
entries.dialogueText: "In these turbulent times, the guiding hand of a king or a queen -- or a Duke or a Duchess -- is more necessary than ever. We shall prove to the world exactly what we are capable of."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We see the Grand Duchy of Pales as..."
entries.dialogueText: "We see the Grand Duchy of Pales as a potential future GRACE member, and a powerful ally. Let today be a step towards that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now... Let the inauguration of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now... Let the inauguration of the Palestream pipeline begin!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a closing word, I would like to..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a closing word, I would like to thank everyone who has worked so hard on the design and construction of this gas pipeline: the engineers and builders, as well as the employees of all the contractors involved."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now... Let the inauguration of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now... Let the inauguration of the Aureus drilling rig begin!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a closing word, I would like to..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a closing word, I would like to thank everyone who has worked so hard on the design and construction of this drilling facility: the engineers and builders, as well as the employees of all the contractors involved."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now... Let the ceremonies begin!""
entries.dialogueText: "Now... Let the ceremonies begin!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a closing word, I would like to..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a closing word, I would like to thank everyone who has worked so hard on reaching a resolution on Aureus. This is an asset for the entire region."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish success to all of you and t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish success to all of you and to all of us in the future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Before I finish, I would also like..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before I finish, I would also like to say a few words about the tragic events that occurred recently."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is a sad reality that misunders..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a sad reality that misunderstandings and lack of communication led to the loss of lives. But we must put this behind us and look ahead."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks to the conciliatory attitud..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to the conciliatory attitude of Duke Reinhart, we managed to reach an agreement in time to avoid further bloodshed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Kingdom of Rizia believes in c..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom of Rizia believes in compassion. We not only forgave each other, but also reached a historic resolution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am still deeply saddened by the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am still deeply saddened by the loss of life that occurred. We must never forget this incident."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you and have a good evening.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you and have a good evening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Congratulations, everybody!""
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations, everybody!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""God bless you all.""
entries.dialogueText: "God bless you all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glovurius axa Rizia axa Pales!""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia axa Pales!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd roared with applause. I g..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd roared with applause. I gave the microphone back to Duke Reinhart.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook my hand and gestured for P..."
entries.dialogueText: He shook my hand and gestured for Prime Minister Alvarez to join us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the moment of the ceremonial val..."
entries.dialogueText: As the moment of the ceremonial valve-turning approached, we walked to the massive valve in the middle of the stage and placed our hands on it, posing for the cameras as we did so.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Instead of the expected mechanical..."
entries.dialogueText: Instead of the expected mechanical hum, the speakers erupted with the sound of whistles and party horns. The music swelled and the geysers went off in unison, enveloping the area in a colorful mist.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the main event approached, a gig..."
entries.dialogueText: As the main event approached, a gigantic faux control panel was wheeled onto the stage. The panel, festooned with blinking lights and oversized buttons, was set for the ceremonial ‘activation’ of the gas field.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Duke Reinhart and Prime Minister Al..."
entries.dialogueText: Duke Reinhart and Prime Minister Alvarez were guided towards the panel, where they were handed gloves to operate the machinery.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Duke Reinhart, Prime Minister Alvar..."
entries.dialogueText: Duke Reinhart, Prime Minister Alvarez and I were guided towards the panel. We placed our hands on it, posing for the cameras as we did so.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a theatrical flourish, they pr..."
entries.dialogueText: With a theatrical flourish, they pressed the buttons and the mock rig came to life. The music swelled and the geysers went off in unison, enveloping the area in a colorful mist.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a series of industrial so..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a series of industrial sounds as the mock rig came to life. The music swelled and the geysers went off in unison, enveloping the area in a colorful mist.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a few more minutes of picture..."
entries.dialogueText: After a few more minutes of picture-taking, we left the stage.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I couldn't help but feel relieved o..."
entries.dialogueText: I couldn't help but feel relieved once we were finally out of Pales.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""To our future partners!""
entries.dialogueText: "To our future partners!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Upon our arrival to Castle Reinhart..."
entries.dialogueText: Upon our arrival to Castle Reinhart, we were greeted by the smiling faces of the Palesian and Lespian delegations as well as Duke Reinhart, waiting for us by the front gate.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Lespia and LesPower are incredibly..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia and LesPower are incredibly pleased that your nations have reached a mutual understanding."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""We will assume shared control over..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will assume shared control over three-quarters of the field, while Rizian Oil and Gas will control the remaining 25 percent."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""The contract for extraction and tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The contract for extraction and transportation of Palesian gas has been given to our state corporation LesPower."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Rizian Oil and Gas will control th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizian Oil and Gas will control the rights to the Rizian half of the field, while Lespia will share control over the Palesian half."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Extraction and transportation from..."
entries.dialogueText: "Extraction and transportation from that half of the field will be carried out by our state corporation LesPower."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""From this point on, the extraction..."
entries.dialogueText: "From this point on, the extraction and transportation of Palesian gas will be handled by us."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""And LesPower of Lespia will receiv..."
entries.dialogueText: "And LesPower of Lespia will receive the sole right to extract resources from the field."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After me, the documents were also p..."
entries.dialogueText: After me, the documents were also passed to Prime Minister Alvarez. As soon as he finished signing, the room broke into a lengthy round of applause.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""To our future partners!""
entries.dialogueText: "To our future partners!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Prime Minister Alvarez then took th..."
entries.dialogueText: Prime Minister Alvarez then took the microphone and started explaining the importance of Aureus and the deal that had been finalized.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a brief introduction, he gave..."
entries.dialogueText: After a brief introduction, he gave the microphone to Duke Reinhart. The Palesian leader made his own brief speech before turning towards me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You must be desperate to get back..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must be desperate to get back and see Manus. As I promised, you may announce your courtship at once."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Manus... Yes, of course. Thank you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Manus... Yes, of course. Thank you so much, Father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As she spoke, her gaze inadvertentl..."
entries.dialogueText: As she spoke, her gaze inadvertently traveled to where Duke Reinhart was standing.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the car, I glanced over at the P..."
entries.dialogueText: In the car, I glanced over at the PAR Aureus Plaque, a celebratory gift from the Rizian Oil and Gas Corporation, sitting snugly on the seat next to me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The city was familiar to me by now...."
entries.dialogueText: The city was familiar to me by now. But the atmosphere was much more cheerful and cordial than it had been during my last visit.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For the second time since my corona..."
entries.dialogueText: For the second time since my coronation, our convoy drove steadily across the cobbled streets of Old Town Pales.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Much obliged.""
entries.dialogueText: "Much obliged."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The best? We lost what should righ..."
entries.dialogueText: "The best? We lost what should rightfully belong to us!"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But we avoided an international in..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we avoided an international incident. That's something to be proud of."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But at what cost? Lespia's getting..."
entries.dialogueText: "But at what cost? Lespia's getting the gas that should belong to us."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""If we play nice with both nations,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we play nice with both nations, we could yet claim a greater share of the rights."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Much obliged.""
entries.dialogueText: "Much obliged."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina was already inside, standing n..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina was already inside, standing next to the Palesian foreign affairs team. She ran to me the moment I entered the hall.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Father! I can't tell you how good..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father! I can't tell you how good it is to see you again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am so, so sorry for what I put y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am so, so sorry for what I put you through."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""There were some scary moments. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "There were some scary moments. But I never actually believed Axel would let anything happen to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did anyone hurt you? You can tell..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did anyone hurt you? You can tell me."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm just fine. Axel and the Palesi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm just fine. Axel and the Palesians took good care of me the whole time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks for your hard work despite..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for your hard work despite the unpleasantness."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Ehm... you're welcome. I was just..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ehm... you're welcome. I was just doing my diplomatic duty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thank the good Lord that you are..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thank the good Lord that you are safe."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I was never in any real trouble. A..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was never in any real trouble. Axel and the Palesians made sure I was taken care of."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This was your greatest challenge a..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was your greatest challenge as a princess yet, and you passed with flying colors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nearly losing you made me realize..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nearly losing you made me realize how much your happiness means to me. Once we're back in Rizia, we'll announce your relationship with Manus straight away."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave me a quick hug."
entries.dialogueText: She gave me a quick hug.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""The houses will be fine with it. Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "The houses will be fine with it. You'll see."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She beamed."
entries.dialogueText: She beamed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm just grateful that the culprit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm just grateful that the culprit has been jailed and we can put this whole mess behind us."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I still can't believe Duchess Azar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still can't believe Duchess Azaro would sabotage our deal like that. She's every bit as war-hungry as the stereotypes"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""The incident slowed things down, o..."
entries.dialogueText: "The incident slowed things down, of course, but my Palesian counterparts and I managed to get the paperwork into shape. All you have to do is sign it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've earned the right to gloat...."
entries.dialogueText: "You've earned the right to gloat. Mr. Prime Minister. You and Reinhart won fair and square."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed. I'm happy we managed to se..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. I'm happy we managed to see through the nefarious forces trying to set us against each other."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Energy really is the great unifier..."
entries.dialogueText: "Energy really is the great unifier, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The smile dropped from his face."
entries.dialogueText: The smile dropped from his face.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I'll say. And there's more than en..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll say. And there's more than enough in the Aureus field to go round."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Your own showing wasn't half bad,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your own showing wasn't half bad, Your Majesty. You had us worried for a moment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What did your friend Dwight have t..."
entries.dialogueText: "What did your friend Dwight have to say about all this?"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""President Walker? I wouldn't know.""
entries.dialogueText: "President Walker? I wouldn't know."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I'll drink to that. After the cere..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll drink to that. After the ceremony, obviously."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll drink to that. What about you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll drink to that. What about you, Alvarez?"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Hm. You said it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hm. You said it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To South Merkopa's newest energy s..."
entries.dialogueText: "To South Merkopa's newest energy superpowers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To the extraordinary opportunities..."
entries.dialogueText: "To the extraordinary opportunities Aureus will bring."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To international cooperation.""
entries.dialogueText: "To international cooperation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a good thing Mother's not her..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a good thing Mother's not here. Wouldn't want her getting ideas for her next outfit."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""She would definitely appreciate......"
entries.dialogueText: "She would definitely appreciate... whatever that is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Making a mockery of God's wonders...."
entries.dialogueText: "Making a mockery of God's wonders... who do they think they are?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook my hand and beckoned me to..."
entries.dialogueText: He shook my hand and beckoned me to follow him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook my hand and smiled appreci..."
entries.dialogueText: He shook my hand and smiled appreciatively as I was ushered into the wings. Prime Minister Alvarez triumphantly took my place.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the moment of the ceremonial val..."
entries.dialogueText: As the moment of the ceremonial valve-turning approached, the three of us walked to the massive valve in the middle and placed our hands on it, posing for the cameras as we did so.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "With a dramatic countdown, we turne..."
entries.dialogueText: With a dramatic countdown, we turned the wheel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Instead of the expected mechanical..."
entries.dialogueText: Instead of the expected mechanical hum, the speakers erupted with the sound of whistles and party horns. The music swelled and the geysers went off in unison, enveloping the area in a colorful mist.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "With a dramatic countdown, Reinhart..."
entries.dialogueText: With a dramatic countdown, Reinhart and I turned the wheel.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get Princess Vina up here. This ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get Princess Vina up here. This honor belongs to her as well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter eagerly bounded up to t..."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter eagerly bounded up to the stage. Together, the three of us turned the wheel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Through the fog, I noticed Vina and..."
entries.dialogueText: Through the fog, I noticed Vina and the Duke of Pales grinning at each other.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get Princess Vina up here. This ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get Princess Vina up here. This honor belongs to her as well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter eagerly bounded up to t..."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter eagerly bounded up to the stage. Together, all four of us turned the wheel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stood in front of a massive boar..."
entries.dialogueText: We stood in front of a massive board with an illustrated map of the Antacean Sea, depicting the Aureus field as a bridge connecting Pales and Lespia.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "With a dramatic countdown, Reinhart..."
entries.dialogueText: With a dramatic countdown, Reinhart, Alvarez and I each pressed one of the buttons on the panel.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get Princess Vina up here. This ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get Princess Vina up here. This honor belongs to her as well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter eagerly bounded up to t..."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter eagerly bounded up to the stage. She, Reinhart, Alvarez and I each pressed one of the buttons.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a series of industrial sounds,..."
entries.dialogueText: With a series of industrial sounds, the mock rig came to life. The music swelled and the geysers went off in unison, enveloping the area in a colorful mist.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a few more minutes of picture..."
entries.dialogueText: After a few more minutes of picture-taking, they left the stage.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together, we identified and punish..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, we identified and punished the responsible party, enabling us to mend our relations and turn over a new leaf."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father King Valero was wrong to..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father King Valero was wrong to mistrust Lespia. With Mr. Alvarez at the helm, I believe the Republic will be a valuable partner to us in the future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My kingdom believes that our partn..."
entries.dialogueText: "My kingdom believes that our partnerships with our neighbors are our greatest asset. We shall continue to foster those partnerships, even at the expense of our own wealth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't bore you all for much long..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't bore you all for much longer. I know you want to see what happens when we turn on that rig."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can see you are getting impatien..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can see you are getting impatient. I will bring my speech to a close."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me with a sly smile."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me with a sly smile.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""As a gesture of gratitude for the..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a gesture of gratitude for the magnanimity of King Romus, we shall also fund the construction of a pipeline from the Aureus field to Rizia. With the volume and price of gas deliveries to be agreed on -- or not -- at a later date."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was here to finalize our deal wit..."
entries.dialogueText: I was here to finalize our deal with Duke Reinhart. After today, Rizia would own the rights to the Aureus gas field -- and a fully operational pipeline to go with it.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: SetRichPresence("Signing an energy deal with Pales and Lespia", "Old Town", "Grand-Duchy of Pales");
